title: Sage ui_option record
description: A ui_option record (OptionRecord). Generated by `sage schema` from the metadata table (issue #21).

$schema.description: The JSON Schema an editor checks this file with; the game ignores it.

id.description: The record's id: name (this file's namespace) or namespace:name. A second definition of an id is an error; change one with "patch".

base.description: Inherit every field from another ui_option record, resolved after patches; this record's own fields win.

patch.description: true: change a record defined earlier in load order, field by field, instead of defining one. Objects merge; lists replace unless written "field+" (add) or "field-" (remove).

abstract.description: true: a template, usable as a "base" and never built into a record itself.

disabled.description: true (in a patch): remove the record.

page.description: The options page it is on: graphics, audio, controls or gameplay. (OptionPage, default "Graphics")

order.description: Where on its page, lowest first; ties go by id. (int, default 0)

label.description: What it is called; '@ns.key' is a localisation key. (string, default "")

kind.description: slider (a number between min and max), toggle (on or off) or choice (one of a list) (OptionKind, default "Slider")

cvar.description: The cvar it reads and sets; a choice may set others instead, with each choice's `set`. (string, default "")

step.description: The values a slider snaps to, from min; 0: any. At least 0. (float, default 0)

percent.description: A slider's value is shown as a percentage of 1 (0.5 is 50%) (bool, default false)

decimals.description: Decimal places a slider's value is shown with. Range: 0 to 6. (int, default 0)

defaultLabel.description: Shown as a slider's value while it is at the cvar's default ("Camera's own" for a fov of 0); '@ns.key' is a localisation key. (string, default "")

on.description: The cvar's value when a toggle is on. (string, default "1")

off.description: The cvar's value when a toggle is off. (string, default "0")

choices.description: A choice's options, in order: each a label and the cvar's value, and/or other cvars it sets (a preset, a resolution) (List<OptionChoice>)

label.description: What it is called; '@ns.key' is a localisation key. (string)

value.description: The option's cvar's value for this choice; empty: it sets only `set`. (string)

set.description: Other cvars it sets, by name: a quality preset's, a resolution's width and height. The choice shown is the first whose values are all as the cvars are. (Dictionary<string, string>)

replace.description: true (in a patch): replace this object with what the patch writes, instead of merging into it.

choices+.description: Adds to "choices": what a base or an earlier definition listed, then these.

label.description: What it is called; '@ns.key' is a localisation key. (string)

value.description: The option's cvar's value for this choice; empty: it sets only `set`. (string)

set.description: Other cvars it sets, by name: a quality preset's, a resolution's width and height. The choice shown is the first whose values are all as the cvars are. (Dictionary<string, string>)

replace.description: true (in a patch): replace this object with what the patch writes, instead of merging into it.

choices-.description: Removes these from "choices" (as a base or an earlier definition listed it).

set.description: Other cvars it sets, by name: a quality preset's, a resolution's width and height. The choice shown is the first whose values are all as the cvars are. (Dictionary<string, string>)

replace.description: true (in a patch): replace this object with what the patch writes, instead of merging into it.

choicesFrom.description: Options a choice takes from the game besides `choices`: languages (each language some mount has strings for) (OptionChoicesFrom, default "None")
